description: Get market-wide campaign-finance rollups across ALL tracked politicians for a cycle: total raised, top 10 individual donors, top 10 PACs, party/chamber/cycle splits, and a most-funded politician leaderboard. Use for "who are the biggest donors in 2024?" or "which party raised more?" type questions. For a single politician, use get_politician_donor_summary.

cycle.description: Election cycle as 4-digit year (e.g. "2024"). Defaults to most recent cycle.
